products.title: Smoked Chilli Hot Sauce, 250ml
products.description: A medium-heat hot sauce built on smoked chillies and cider vinegar, fermented for three weeks before bottling.

products.title: Habanero & Mango Hot Sauce, 250ml
products.description: A fruit-forward hot sauce balancing habanero heat against ripe mango. Hot but not punishing.

products.title: Seville Orange Marmalade, 340g
products.description: A thick-cut marmalade made in a single winter batch from Seville oranges, set without added pectin.

products.title: Blackcurrant Preserve, 340g
products.description: A soft-set blackcurrant preserve with a high fruit ratio and noticeably less sugar than a standard jam.

products.title: Wild Garlic Pesto, 190g
products.description: A seasonal pesto of foraged wild garlic, toasted walnuts and hard cheese. Refrigerate after opening.

products.title: Pickled Walnuts, 400g
products.description: Green walnuts pickled in spiced malt vinegar, matured for six months. Traditional accompaniment to cold meats.

products.title: Fennel & Sea Salt Crackers, 150g
products.description: Thin sourdough crackers baked with fennel seed and finished with flaked sea salt.

products.title: Aged Balsamic Vinegar, 100ml
products.description: A twelve-year aged balsamic, thick enough to coat a spoon. Sold in a wax-sealed bottle.

products.title: Cold Pressed Rapeseed Oil, 500ml
products.description: A single-estate cold pressed rapeseed oil with a grassy finish, suitable for dressing or medium-heat cooking.

products.title: Salted Caramel Sauce, 220g
products.description: A pouring caramel made with unsalted butter and finished with sea salt flakes. Keeps four weeks refrigerated.

pages.about: Kestrel Provisions makes preserves, sauces and pantry goods in small batches from a production kitchen. We cook in open pans rather than industrial vessels, which limits how much we can make but keeps the flavour where we want it.
pages.refund_policy: Unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Opened food items cannot be returned unless faulty or incorrectly supplied, in which case we refund or replace in full. Damaged-in-transit items are replaced on receipt of a photograph.
pages.shipping_policy: Orders dispatched within 2 business days. Standard delivery $6.50, free over $60, arriving in 3-5 business days. Glass items are packed in moulded pulp trays.
